domain_description: Comprehensive probate and estate administration analysis covering will contests, estate administration, trust administration, guardianship proceedings, heirship determination, probate litigation, estate planning, and fiduciary duty analysis. Grounded in the Uniform Probate Code, Texas Estates Code, Uniform Trust Code, Restatement of Trusts, and state-specific probate statutes.
authority_sources: Restatement (Third) of Property: Wills and Other Donative Transfers
American College of Trust and Estate Counsel (ACTEC) Commentaries

engines.name: Will Contest Engine
engines.function: Analyze will contest claims including testamentary capacity, undue influence, fraud, duress, improper execution, and standing requirements. Evaluate evidence for challenge and defense strategies under state probate codes.
doctrine_topics: testamentary capacity requirements and burden of proof
undue influence elements and circumstantial evidence
fraud in the inducement vs fraud in the execution
duress and coercion in will execution
standing to contest a will (interested persons)
statute of limitations for will contests
burden shifting in undue influence cases

golden_queries.question: A 92-year-old testator executed a new will 3 weeks before death, disinheriting 4 children and leaving everything to a live-in caregiver who drove the testator to the attorney's office. The prior will divided the estate equally among the children. Two of the children want to contest. Analyze the undue influence and testamentary capacity claims.
required_elements: undue influence elements (susceptibility, opportunity, disposition, coveted result)
testamentary capacity standard (know nature of property, natural objects of bounty, testamentary plan)
failure_signals: no discussion of confidential relationship presumption

engines.name: Estate Administration Engine
engines.function: Analyze estate administration procedures including probate of wills, appointment of personal representatives, creditor claims, asset marshaling, distribution, and accounting under dependent and independent administration.
doctrine_topics: probate application and will admission procedures
creditor claims process and priority (secured, unsecured, priority)
family allowance, homestead, and exempt property
closing estate and discharge of personal representative

golden_queries.question: A decedent dies in Texas with a will naming an independent executor. The estate includes a homestead, $500,000 in investments, $200,000 in debts (including a $150,000 mortgage), and a pending personal injury lawsuit valued at $300,000. The estate is insolvent if the lawsuit is excluded. Analyze the administration priorities and creditor claim handling.
required_elements: independent administration procedures under Texas Estates Code
family allowance and exempt property set-aside

engines.name: Trust Administration Engine
engines.function: Analyze trust administration issues including trustee duties, investment standards, trust accounting, beneficiary rights, trust modification, and termination under the Uniform Trust Code and state trust law.
doctrine_topics: prudent investor rule and investment standards (UPIA)
beneficiary rights to information and accounting
directed trust and trust protector provisions

golden_queries.question: A trustee of a $10 million irrevocable trust invested 80% in a single stock (the family business) and 20% in cash. The trust instrument says 'the trustee may retain any asset received from the settlor.' The stock has declined 40% in value. The income beneficiary demands the trustee diversify. Analyze the trustee's duty to diversify vs the retention clause.
required_elements: trustee's duty to review retained assets
trustee liability for failure to diversify
failure_signals: failure to address retention clause effect

engines.name: Guardianship Engine
engines.function: Analyze guardianship and conservatorship proceedings for incapacitated persons and minors including determination of incapacity, guardian appointment, powers and duties, alternatives to guardianship, and guardianship termination.
doctrine_topics: guardian of the person vs guardian of the estate

golden_queries.question: An 80-year-old parent with early-stage dementia owns $2 million in assets and a home. Two adult children disagree about care and finances. One child seeks full guardianship while the other argues for a supported decision-making agreement. The parent can still express preferences but struggles with complex financial decisions. Analyze the appropriate level of intervention.
required_elements: court investigation and attorney ad litem role

engines.name: Heirship Determination Engine
engines.function: Analyze heirship determination proceedings for intestate decedents including intestate succession rules, affidavits of heirship, judicial declarations of heirship, and the effect of heirship determinations on property title.
doctrine_topics: intestate succession statutory framework by state
per stirpes vs per capita distribution methods
community property vs separate property in intestacy
affidavit of heirship requirements and limitations
unknown heir search and notice requirements
posthumous and nonmarital child heirship rights
heirship determination effect on real property title

golden_queries.question: A Texas mineral owner died intestate in 1975 with no surviving spouse. He had 3 children (one of whom predeceased him leaving 2 grandchildren), an adopted child, and a non-marital child who was never formally acknowledged. The minerals are community property acquired during a prior marriage. No probate was ever opened. Analyze the heirship and the procedure needed to clear title to the mineral interest.
required_elements: Texas intestate succession for community property
per stirpes representation for predeceased child's share
non-marital child inheritance rights and proof
judicial declaration of heirship procedure for clearing title
failure_signals: failure to address non-marital child rights

engines.name: Probate Litigation Engine
engines.function: Analyze probate-related litigation including fiduciary breach claims, beneficiary disputes, trust contests, accounting objections, and fee disputes in the probate court system.
doctrine_topics: breach of fiduciary duty claims and remedies
mediation and settlement in probate disputes
damages and disgorgement for fiduciary breach
statute of limitations for probate claims

golden_queries.question: A trustee of a family trust made a $1 million loan to his own business at below-market interest rates without beneficiary consent. The loan was partially repaid but $400,000 remains outstanding and the business has filed bankruptcy. Analyze the breach of fiduciary duty, available remedies, and potential trustee liability.
required_elements: self-dealing prohibition and duty of loyalty
no further inquiry rule for self-dealing
failure_signals: failure to identify no further inquiry rule

engines.name: Estate Planning Engine
engines.function: Analyze estate planning strategies including will and trust drafting, tax minimization, asset protection, business succession planning, charitable giving, and incapacity planning using revocable trusts, irrevocable trusts, and advanced techniques.
doctrine_topics: revocable living trust vs will-based estate plan
family limited partnership and LLC planning
charitable remainder and charitable lead trusts
power of attorney and healthcare directive drafting
asset protection trust planning (domestic and foreign)
business succession planning and buy-sell agreements

golden_queries.question: A married couple (both age 60) has a combined estate of $30 million including a $10 million family business, $5 million in real estate, and $15 million in investments. They want to minimize estate taxes, provide for their 3 children, and transition the business to 2 of the 3 children. Design an estate plan framework.
required_elements: GRAT or SLAT for wealth transfer

engines.name: Fiduciary Duty Engine
engines.function: Analyze fiduciary duty obligations of executors, trustees, guardians, and agents under powers of attorney including duty of loyalty, prudence, impartiality, and the duty to account, with standards drawn from the Restatement of Trusts and state fiduciary codes.
doctrine_topics: duty of loyalty and prohibition on self-dealing
duty of prudence and reasonable care standard
duty to account and provide information
duty to administer and not delegate improperly

golden_queries.question: A trust has an income beneficiary (surviving spouse, age 75) and remainder beneficiaries (3 adult children). The trustee invests the $5 million trust entirely in growth stocks with no dividend yield, generating zero income distributions for the spouse. The trust instrument is silent on the power to adjust. Analyze the trustee's breach of duty of impartiality and available remedies.
required_elements: duty of impartiality between income and remainder beneficiaries
total return investing and unitrust conversion
power to adjust under Uniform Principal and Income Act
beneficiary remedies for breach of impartiality
failure_signals: failure to discuss total return or unitrust approach
